ui.title: Simulator
ui.save_data: Data saver is on: PlayShelf is a few megabytes to download.
ui.theme_changed: The theme changed: restart to give it to the console too.
ui.other_help: Any other PLAYSHELF_SIM_* variable, by its name in lower case without the prefix: one this page does not know yet (from a newer build) still reaches PlayShelf.
ui.note: Apply restarts PlayShelf from a fresh state with these settings; what you change inside it is not kept, unless “Keep the state” is on. The console takes the page's language and theme.
ui.keys: <kbd>↑↓←→</kbd> move · <kbd>Enter</kbd> A · <kbd>Esc</kbd> B · <kbd>X</kbd> <kbd>Y</kbd> · <kbd>L</kbd> <kbd>R</kbd> · <kbd>⇧L</kbd> ZL · <kbd>⇧R</kbd> ZR · <kbd>+</kbd> <kbd>−</kbd> · a click is a touch
ui.no_isolation: This browser does not let the page run threads (no cross-origin isolation). Try a recent Chrome, Edge or Firefox, outside a private window.
ui.no_webgl: This browser has no WebGL 2, which PlayShelf draws with.
ui.steps_help: A link that starts PlayShelf as it started here and replays what you did since
ui.tour_home: Home: where the console and its servers stand, what your games miss, the servers' newest games and games for you.
ui.tour_library: Library: the games on this console, their versions, and what a server has that is newer.
ui.tour_catalogue: Catalogue: a library server's games, here the demo shelf's made-up ones.
ui.tour_game: A game's sheet: its base game, its updates and add-ons, each one to install.
ui.tour_download: Install everything: its packages go to the downloads and are installed one after the other.
ui.tour_downloads: Downloads: the queue, each game's timeline, and how the packages are fetched.
ui.tour_preferences: Preferences: the language, the theme and the title database.
ui.tour_end: Your turn: the arrows move, Enter is A, Esc is B. The panel sets any state.

keep.label: Keep the state between visits
keep.help: PlayShelf's data (its settings, servers and downloads) and what the simulated console has installed stay in this browser; the console settings of this panel then count for a first start only.

fw.label: Firmware
fw.help: Above the newest verified one, the firmware screen.

hbloader.label: A loader that can hand an update to a store

latest.label: Latest release : newest firmware it supports

store.label: The Homebrew App Store's version (with its record on the SD card)

signed.label: Demo packages taken as signed by Nintendo
signed.help: On by default with the demo server. Off: each install asks first, as a package not signed by Nintendo does on a console.

free_mb.label: Free space for installs (MB)
free_mb.help: 0: the SD card is full, and an install stops on it.
